lines.text: Researchers found stone tools that are three point three million years old.
That's more than three times a million years.
lines.cue: caption: MORE THAN 3 x A MILLION

lines.text: They came seven hundred thousand years before the next known tool tradition, the Oldowan.
And they were still lying where they were left.
lines.cue: caption: STILL WHERE THEY WERE LEFT

lines.text: NASA says the Apollo footprints on the Moon will probably last millions of years.
lines.cue: caption: MOON FOOTPRINTS: MILLIONS OF YEARS

lines.text: Now suppose every human vanished. After a million years, our best bet is three kinds of things.
Stone is one. The Moon is another. The third is already in the ground on Earth.
So what is the third? The full video on our channel has the answer. Like and subscribe so you don't miss the next one.
